visual_review.notes: Full face inspected: Chaos Spell, 2 Energy and 1 Chaos Power; either controller's unit with 3 Might or less. No Action/Reaction. Flow costs 4 Energy and 1 Chaos Power.

findings: The Might limit and ability to choose either controller are live target restrictions. Destination is declared before responses.
A selected base retains its physical player identity even if the unit later changes controller. An invalid foreign-base destination instead Recalls under449.2.c; Recall does not emit a Move event.
Flow changes zone and cost, not spell timing, and banishes the spell after resolution.
